package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var left = Type("Left", func() {

	OneOf("inner", func() {
		Attribute("left", String)
		Attribute("right", String)
	})
	Required("inner")

})
var right = Type("Right", func() {

	OneOf("other_inner", func() {
		Attribute("one", String)
		Attribute("two", String)
	})
	Required("other_inner")

})
var data = Type("Data", func() {

	OneOf("outer", func() {
		Attribute("left", left)
		Attribute("right", right)
	})
	Required("outer")

})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {
	Method("send", func() {
		Payload(data)
		Result(data)
		HTTP(func() {
			POST("/send")
		})
	})
})
